metadata.title: Mobile Telemetry Normalization

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for producing consistent, decision-grade mobile telemetry to support Zero Trust access and risk evaluation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile telemetry collection, normalization pipelines, signal abstraction layers, and policy consumption interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern for translating heterogeneous telemetry into normalized and bounded security signals.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Telemetry Normalization aligns with NIST guidance on security logging, monitoring, and Zero Trust decision inputs.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Telemetry Normalization defines how raw mobile telemetry is transformed into normalized, privacy-bounded signals suitable for risk-based access decisions. This pattern ensures telemetry supports trust decisions without enabling surveillance or excessive data retention.

components.title: Scoped Mobile Telemetry Collection
components.description: Ensures only security-relevant mobile telemetry is collected, excluding personal or non-essential data.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System and device information discovery beyond legitimate security needs.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information collection is limited to authorized purposes.
Security safeguards explicitly constrain monitoring scope.

components.title: Mobile Telemetry Normalization
components.description: Transforms heterogeneous mobile telemetry into standardized signal categories usable by policy and access systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or suppression of security telemetry.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Standardized telemetry representation ensures consistent interpretation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mobile telemetry events are generated in a consistent and interpretable format.

components.title: Mobile Telemetry Signal Abstraction
components.description: Abstracts normalized telemetry into high-level posture and risk signals for consumption by Zero Trust systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of over-trusted context due to ambiguous signals.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Signal abstraction prevents raw telemetry from being over-trusted.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Risk signals are derived from telemetry for access decisions.
Mobile access decisions incorporate abstracted device risk.

components.title: Mobile Telemetry Retention Boundary
components.description: Constrains retention and downstream use of mobile telemetry to prevent secondary use or mission creep.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection and retention of excessive historical data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Retention controls enforce data lifecycle boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit record retention is defined and limited.
Information handling is restricted to approved uses.
